name: Minesweeper
author: Henrique Barcia Lang
description: The classic mine-clearing puzzle: tap a cell to open it, numbers tell how many mines touch it. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: The classic mine-clearing puzzle: tap a cell to open it, numbers tell how many mines touch it. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Il classico rompicapo delle mine: tocca una casella per scoprirla, i numeri dicono quante mine la toccano. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
